experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
bullets: Led requirement workshops and documented business processes for cross-functional delivery initiatives
Supported stakeholder alignment by clarifying priorities, dependencies, and acceptance criteria
Guided junior analysts on UAT planning, issue tracking, and requirement quality

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Prepared user stories, process maps, and testing support documents for internal projects
Worked with delivery teams to track actions and support solution rollout planning

projects.name: Order Management Process Redesign
projects.impact: Improved clarity of workflow ownership and reduced handoff confusion
